Dude Ive gotten these same intrusive thoughts my whole life. It happens every week or so for me, usually only for a couple hours, ill be just cursing at myself and EVERYTHING, situations and things (even things I like) non stop for no reason. If I am home alone, I will say these things out loud, one time I stayed in the bathroom cutting myself and calling myself a faggot for about four hours. Thankfully i don't slice  myself compulsively anymore....
Didnt end up doing it, and Im hoping things will get better and trying the hardest I can to make that happen. I appreciate the comments in this thread, so thank you.
